depiction_rules.notes: Show the youthful prince and forest exile appropriate to the stanza; he is not shown with Krishna's peacock feather or Guruvayurappan's murti ornaments.

visual_bible.face: calm, noble youthful face with distinct almond eyes and a composed expression
visual_bible.skin: soft muted blue, consistent across all D034 scenes
visual_bible.hair: dark hair tied in a small practical topknot
visual_bible.crown: simple princely headband or bare head in forest exile; no peacock feather
visual_bible.clothing: warm ochre or muted yellow dhoti; simple saffron wrap during exile
visual_bible.jewelry: restrained traditional ornaments, reduced during forest exile
visual_bible.attributes: long bow and quiver only when the scene requires them; natural human two arms and two legs

never: no glossy skin or metallic gold
keep bow, hands and fingers connected and anatomically plausible
